#load data brut
```{r}
data_specimen <- load_specimen(path = databrut, namesheet = "Specimens")
data_station <- load_station(path = databrut, namesheet = "Stations")
data_lac <- load_lac(path = databrut, namesheet = "Lac")
data_recolte <- load_recolte(path = databrut, namesheet = "Recolte")
#pas besoin des autres pour le moment
```
Création specimen
```{r}
specimen <- inner_join(
      x = data_specimen,
      y = data_station,
      by = c("no_station", "annee", "nom_lac", "no_lac", "typ_pech"),
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) %>% droplevels()  %>% dplyr::distinct()
```
Creation capture
```{r}
capture <- inner_join(
      x = data_recolte,
      y = data_station,
      by = c("no_station", "annee", "nom_lac", "no_lac", "typ_pech"),
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) %>% droplevels()  %>% dplyr::distinct()
```
CPUE, ca marche mais mis en veille pcq cest long
```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
temp <- selection_modele_CPUE_tous(
        capture = capture,
        specimen = specimen,
        espece = "SAVI",
        station = data_station
      ) %>% as.data.frame()

  selection_modele_CPUE_tous_data <- temp %>% rename('IC 95%' = IC95,
                            "Ajustement (résultat du test HNP)" = Ajustement)
    temp
```
